import json
def block_state():
    rows = current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
    cells=[(i,j) for i in range(34,44) for j in range(27,37) if rows[i][j]=='p']
    return len(cells)
def check(tag):
    r = last_action_result
    print(tag, 'purple=', block_state(), 'done=', r.get('done'), 'lvl=', r.get('level_completed'), 'over=', r.get('game_over'))
# Test C: purple NE-diamond stamp
action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':4,'col':38}])
action(['SPACE'])
check('C D_NE_p')
if last_action_result.get('done') or last_action_result.get('level_completed'):
    print('SOLVED C'); result='C'
else:
    # reset to all white
    action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':4,'col':32}])
    action(['SPACE'])
    check('reset')
    # Test A: rectangle purple (top 5 rows)
    action(['LEFT'])
    action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':4,'col':38}])
    action(['SPACE'])
    check('A T_p')
    if last_action_result.get('done') or last_action_result.get('level_completed'):
        print('SOLVED A'); result='A'
    else:
        action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':4,'col':32}])
        action(['SPACE'])
        check('reset2')
        # Test B: NW diamond purple
        action(['LEFT'])
        action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':4,'col':38}])
        action(['SPACE'])
        check('B D_NW_p')
        result = 'B' if (last_action_result.get('done') or last_action_result.get('level_completed')) else 'none of C/A/B'
print('RESULT', result)
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
